status: proposal requiring independent source reconstruction and endpoint replay
equivalence: exact rational projection equivalence to the selected parent, including zero branches

root.allocation: append exactly two fresh root coordinates and two residual rows; no new lift gates
root.changed_calls: only the designated existing common-field argument pair of all 37 comparator calls

comparison_delta.common_slot_outside_use: none in residuals; exactly one use in the designated batch coefficient pair
comparison_delta.new_channel_type: coefficients of the square of the original shared field F
comparison_delta.metadata_required: explicit designated field index, pre-squared coefficient type, original order 1 and retained original field F=conj(f(J)); never silently reinterpret as an ordinary field input

batch_delta.delete: only the designated private Y and its defining row
batch_delta.retain: W, its exact tree position, all other fields/orders/powers, private conic, literal-one tree and pole
batch_delta.renumber: uniform bijection on every later local variable and row index; check every metadata reference
batch_delta.private_Y_outside_use: exactly the two old rows; no call argument, foreign row, or different field binding

maps.forward: C=A^2+2B^2, D=2AB; delete 37 Y; retain all other coordinates
maps.reverse: Y_j=A+theta_j*B separately for each batch; delete C,D; retain all other coordinates

negative_cases_required: wrong root square coefficient, conjugation sign, C/D order, or original source coefficient
missing root square row, fresh-coordinate collision, or alteration of an original root equation
one wrong designated root call pair in each comparator mode
wrong pre-squared channel type, field index, original order, or reused ordinary-field checker
missing or extra designated Y deletion, hidden Y row consumer, or hidden Y call consumer
wrong r^2 power, theta from another private batch, changed W, or wrong upper-tree position
changed non-designated field, contact power, conic row, literal-one leaf, or pole input
bad variable/row remapping, extra content, flattened row corruption, or construction-map corruption
timeout/resource failure must abort; never count it as a semantic rejection
